text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein receives delegates attending Arab Satellite Communication Organisation meetings in Amman; says he endorses efforts by corporation to advance Arab telecommunications.
- Prime Minister Majali agrees to convening of conference organised by opposition to back Arab stance on Jerusalem.

- Crown Prince Hassan stresses to visiting German delegation need for regional cooperation to find solutions to water shortage in Middle East. Germany agrees to annual aid package to Jordan; pledges increase in financial commitments in 1997 in support of Jordan's regional role.
- Iraq stresses desire to develop ties with Jordan.
- Jordan plans to issue $70 million debut sovereign Eurobond within four months, Jordan's deputy central bank governor Michele Marto tells bankers in conference in London.
- Washington seeks ways to increase aid to Jordan, does not rule out taking money from its traditional allocation to Israel.
- Omani committee to recruit Jordanian teachers for coming academic year expected in Amman next week.
- Jordan to award by year-end a tender to an international refiner to build a proposed export refinery in Red Sea port of Aqaba, says energy official.
